levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حدثنا أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation (a relation link). The Imam Abu Ja'far inside the chain after «عن» stays narrator (owner ruling 2). The Prophet is the end, not a link.
«آبائه» is a plural relation with no name, read as a relation link; the blessings and «رضي الله عنهما» are left out.
